title: ActionProposalOutcome
description: Unit U26's real, immediate result of proposing an action outside the tuning pipeline (`POST /api/v1/actions/propose`) — mirrors `core::policy::PolicyOutcome`'s three variants (`AutoAllowed`, `PendingApproval`, `Denied`) field-for-field, the same way `TuningPlanOutcome` mirrors `TuningOutcome`. `status` is one of `"AUTO_ALLOWED"`, `"PENDING_APPROVAL"`, `"DENIED"`; `approval_expires_at` is set only for `PENDING_APPROVAL`, `reason` only for `DENIED`.
